sections: A.22 VT_PUT_QUEUE, VT_READ_PQ, VT_WRITE_PQ and VT_DELETE_PQ
source.evidence_limit: Reference tray IDs and cell ordering do not supply a native calibrated pattern or Seq algorithm; geometry and ordering below are explicit portable choices

contract.configuration: Optional bounded vision.tracking.vt.trays bank with complete local XYZWPR cell transforms, optional model overrides and explicit sequence choice
contract.insertion: Apply input pose:cell transform to offset and existing views only; preserve missing views/measurements; preflight complete batch capacity, IDs, geometry, budget and routing before publishing
contract.identity: Distinct internal cell indexes with shared caller ID allowed only within one explicit tray instance; retain original detection fingerprint for duplicate checks
contract.allocation: Each cell owns its routing and once-only receipt; ACK2 forwards only its adjusted cell, preserving instance and ordinal; other cells remain independent
contract.ordering: Filter ordinary eligibility first; a sequenced instance occupies its first sorted slot, with remaining eligible cells in supplied order; no native Seq claim
contract.persistence: Retain checked patterns, partial results, instance/origin metadata and allocation receipts; reject forged index/pattern/group ownership; no suspended task restoration
contract.compatibility: No matching pattern preserves existing single tagged-part behavior; VT_PUT_QUE2 still requires tray zero

boundaries: No calibrated tray/grid discovery, native status/ABI, motion, encoder updates, automatic frame conversion or strict equivalence
